sloka: निहतं सारथिं दृष्ट्वा समरे रावणात्मजः।प्रजहौ समरोद्धर्षं विषण्णः स बभूव ह ।। ६.९०.४७ ।।
transliteration: nihataṁ sārathiṁ dṛṣṭvā samare rāvaṇātmajaḥ।prajahau samaroddharṣaṁ viṣaṇṇaḥ sa babhūva ha ।। 6.90.47 ।।

translations.english: The Vanara leaders were joyful upon seeing the worried face of the Rakshasa and acclaimed Lakshmana.
